department: Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefit: You get a bank loan to start a small trading or business unit. The project can cost up to Rs 15 lakh. The government pays 25% of the project cost as a subsidy, up to Rs 3.75 lakh.

other: Age 18 to 45. For women, minorities, BC, MBC, SC, ST, ex-servicemen, transgender people and people with disabilities, the upper age is 55.
You must have passed at least 8th standard.
Your family income must be below Rs 8 lakh a year.
You put in 10% of the project cost yourself (5% for special categories).

documents: School or college Transfer Certificate or record sheet (2 copies)
Ration card (2 copies), or nativity certificate, Aadhaar or voter ID if you have no ration card
Ex-servicemen, disability or transgender certificate if it applies to you
Affidavit on Rs 20 stamp paper signed by a Notary Public
how_to_apply: Fill the UYEGP application form. Send it with your papers to the District Industries Centre in your district.
where_to_apply: District Industries Centre (DIC) in your district
